description: Remove a composed group from an application environment. The group and its secrets are untouched — only the link is dropped — but the environment stops resolving every name it inherited from that group, which will break a workload still reading one. Check list_env_groups first, and use delete_group to destroy the group itself. Safe to repeat. Returns { ok: true }.

app.description: Application slug or id, as returned by list_apps (e.g. "storefront").

env.description: Environment slug or id within that application, as returned by list_envs (e.g. "production").

group.description: Shared-group slug or id, as returned by list_groups (e.g. "shared-datastores").

org.description: Organization slug or id. Omit it when the credential can reach exactly one org — that org is used automatically. With several, the error names every slug you may pass; list them yourself with list_orgs.

name: uncompose_group
